title: Spacecraft GNC Engineer II at Varda Space Industries Optimistic About Expanding Opportunities in In-Orbit Manufacturing and Hypersonic Testing
expert: Spacecraft GNC Engineer II at Varda Space Industries (current; launch customer and LEO peer); interview 2026-08-07
verdict: A current Varda engineer (a SpaceX launch customer, interviewed 2026-08-07) gives no SpaceX figures of his own; he expects Starship online in "the next few years" to cut launch cost and sees LEO communications "a bit saturated" by Starlink and Amazon.

Starship reuse and launch cost (Tenet 5): 🟢 Starship expected online in "the next few years" (estimate) as falling launch costs widen in-orbit manufacturing demand; mgmt already had Flight 14 in orbit with 26 V3 satellites (SB #65090): consistent. → Tenet 5 (Starship reuse) ↑ {c2}
🟢 Varda demand "almost 50/50" government hypersonic testing vs pharma (estimate); first read on in-orbit manufacturing demand that rides SpaceX launches. {c4}
Starlink net adds and ARPU: 🟡 LEO communications "a bit saturated" by Starlink and Amazon, hard for new entrants; first read, no subscriber or ARPU figure. → Tenet 4 (Starlink compounds) → {c6}

changes: Starship timing "the next few years" (estimate, interview 2026-08-07) vs mgmt: Flight 14 reached orbit and deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites (SB #65090, 2026-10-20): later evidence is already ahead of the expert's view.
